title: Makonde Peanut Porridge
community: Makonde people of Mtwara — the peanut breakfast of the south
author: Mama Salima
desc: Makonde Peanut Porridge — cassava or maize flour porridge enriched with freshly ground roasted peanuts and sweetened with honey. The high-protein breakfast of southern Tanzania — the Makonde peanut enrichment of the morning porridge makes it one of the most sustaining breakfasts in the country.
longDesc: Makonde peanut porridge is the breakfast that sustains southern Tanzania's great carvers through long hours of work — the combination of cassava starch and groundnut protein provides energy that lasts well into the afternoon.
ingredients: 1 cup cassava flour or maize flour
3 tbsp freshly roasted and ground groundnuts
steps: Whisk flour with 1 cup cold water until smooth.
Bring remaining 3 cups water to a simmer.
Pour flour mixture in slowly, whisking constantly.
Remove from heat. Add honey and salt.
chefTips: Freshly roasted peanuts produce far more flavour than commercial peanut butter.
cookingScience: See TZA246 for porridge cooking science. The addition of groundnut protein to a starch-based porridge creates a more complete amino acid profile — the lysine from groundnuts complements the methionine in the cassava flour.
sustainabilityTips: Both cassava and groundnuts are drought-resistant — perfect for Mtwara's challenging climate.
healthBenefits: Complete protein from cassava and groundnut combination.
culturalNote: Makonde peanut porridge is the breakfast of the carvers — sustaining the remarkable artistic tradition of the Makonde people through long hours of intricate work. The food and the art are connected: both require patience, both require local resources, both define the Makonde.
